[[File:Locust rider icon.png|left]]
'''Locust riders''' are encountered during the [[Contact!]] [[quest]], inside the [[Sophanem Dungeon]]. The level 98 riders attack using somewhat slow, but strong [[Ranged]] attacks with a max hit of 22. The level 106 version uses a spear for [[melee]] and has a lower max hit of 15, but attacks faster than the rangers. Remember that you need to bring a [[light source]] when you are in the dungeon.

Locust riders are scattered throughout the dungeon. They frequently hit over 20, so [[Prayer#Prayers|Protection Prayers]] and good [[food]] are recommended, especially if multiple riders are encountered.

The [[Keris]] dagger and [[Keris partisan|Keris Partisan]] special effects work against them.

Though not directly assigned, Locust riders may be slain as part of a [[Scabarite]] assignment. These monsters respawn at an extremely fast rate, so it may be ideal to stay in one spot.

A good strategy to kill these is to wear prayer-boosting armour, such as [[Proselyte armour]] and use [[Protect from Missiles]] as the rangers can hit harder than the meleers and from further away. When your prayer gets low, go back up to [[Sophanem]] and recharge your prayer at the [[High Priest (Sophanem)|High Priest]]'s altar, or after the completion of [[Contact!]], the altar right above the bank.
